name: academic-writing-agents
description: Academic writing plugin for Codex: an orchestrator, 12 specialist skills, and 30 shared principles.

author.name: Haiwen Huang; Codex adaptation by chughtapan

interface.shortDescription: Review, research, draft, and polish academic writing
interface.longDescription: Review, research, draft, and polish academic manuscripts with an orchestrator and 12 individually invokable specialist skills. Includes 30 writing principles, bibliography audits, literature surveys, and LaTeX figure and layout support.
defaultPrompt: Use $academic to review my manuscript and prioritize improvements.
Use $bibliography-auditor to verify the references in my paper.
Use $prose-polisher to improve clarity while preserving my claims.
